sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *mind* (all) goes after a plural subject and says that every one of them is included: *A barátok mind itt vannak.* Unlike *sok*, *néhány* and *több*, it comes with a plural noun and the plural verb *vannak*, because the noun already names the whole group. It combines with *együtt*: *A gyerekek mind együtt vannak.*

sections.title: Two ways to say how many

sections.content: Compare *Sok ember van itt* (a quantity, singular noun) with *Az emberek mind itt vannak* (the whole group, plural noun). *sok* counts; *mind* points at a group you have already named.
